$comment: Bead's conversations: what a server of the interop service (interop-service.json) does with what one client sends, played by every implementation's tests against its own server.
A step is what the test does, or what the server under test does next. send is what the client sends, in hexadecimal as vectors.json writes it; close closes the client's connection.

expect is the next envelope the server sends: its kind, its call id, and its payload or its failure; a request, its flags, its service and its procedure too. A failure compares its code, its scope and the relays it crossed; its detail is informative. session, on an answer, says what it announced: announced for a token, which is random, ended for 16 zero bytes; none, nothing. A result that opens a transfer gives its total too; a chunk, its offset, whether it is the last, and its payload; a credit, its end.
report is the next thing the server reports to its application: a protocol code, or exception for an error that carries none.
Before each send, after close, and at the end, nothing more was sent or reported: what a conversation does not expect, a server does not do.
limits, where given, are the server's limits; any other is its default. pacing, where given, bounds the queues of its paced subscriptions.
clauses are the units of spec.md an entry checks: a clause, 9.2; an item of its numbered list, 9.2.5; a row of its table, counted from 1, 15.6.8.

conversations.name: echo answers with its request's payload
fail answers with its own failure, of the application
a service unknown is answered SERVICE_UNKNOWN
a procedure unknown, in a service known, is answered PROCEDURE_UNKNOWN
an admission that refuses is answered with its refusal
a request with a destination, to a server that relays nothing, is answered DESTINATION_UNKNOWN
a request that opens a transfer, to a server that takes none, is answered PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE
a request that opens a subscription to a procedure that notifies nothing is answered, and holds nothing
a resolver that throws before it answers is answered PROCEDURE_FAILED, and reported
a payload that is not JSON is answered PAYLOAD_UNDECODABLE
an admission is asked before the payload is read: one that is not JSON is refused by it, not undecodable
an answer too large for one envelope, from a server that sends no transfer, is answered PROCEDURE_FAILED, and reported PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE
a result that fits in one envelope only without the session an answer may announce is refused as one that does not
the server asks its client a command, and answers with what the client answered
a command the client fails fails the call that asked it, which is reported
an answer to a command that does not read ends the command and cancels it, and a late one is dropped in silence
a request that opens a subscription to ticks is answered, and each tick notifies it on its call id
a request to ticks that opens no subscription subscribes nothing
a call id a subscription holds is in use: a request on it is reported, never answered
a cancel ends a subscription, and nothing more goes on its call id
a later subscription to the same procedure is answered and holds nothing: the first keeps it
a notification may come before the answer of the call it travels on
a call answered while the first is unanswered waits, and takes the place when the first is cancelled
a call answered while the first is unanswered waits, and takes the place when the first fails
a paced subscription is sent a notification per credit, the first credited by its request
a keyed notification replaces the one of its key waiting, in its place
a credit no higher than the last grants nothing
a credit lower than the last takes nothing back: the highest stands
a queue past its bounds ends an answered subscription with a failure on its call id
a queue past its bounds while its call is unanswered is that call's answer
a procedure that requires a session refuses a connection without one with SESSION_REQUIRED
a session opened is announced by the next answer, and only by it
a session ended is announced by the next answer, and only by it
a session opened again is announced again, its token drawn anew
a session that ends ends its connection's subscriptions, the first answer to go out announcing it
a request presenting a session is read, and its session ignored
a request on the server's own parity is reported, never answered
a request on a call id still open is reported, never answered
a cancel ends its call, and the answer its resolver gives after goes nowhere
a call id cancelled is opened again, and the first call's answer does not answer the second
a connection that closes ends its calls, and their answers go nowhere
a cancel on the server's own parity is reported
a cancel for no call crossed its answer, and is dropped in silence
a message shorter than a prefix is reported
a first byte no layout is, is reported
a request of a layout to come is answered LAYOUT_UNSUPPORTED, on its call id
a request of a layout to come, on the server's own parity, is reported
a malformed request is answered ENVELOPE_MALFORMED, on its call id
a malformed request on a call id still open is reported, never answered
a request past the envelope's bound is answered ENVELOPE_TOO_LARGE, on its call id
a kind to come is reported KIND_UNSUPPORTED
an advisory kind is skipped
a result for no call is reported CALL_UNKNOWN
a failure for no call is reported CALL_UNKNOWN
a notification is reported KIND_UNSUPPORTED by a server, which takes none
a chunk for no call is reported CALL_UNKNOWN
a chunk on a call open without a transfer is reported ENVELOPE_MALFORMED
a credit of notifications, for no subscription, is dropped in silence by a server, which sends them
a credit of bytes, for no transfer, is dropped in silence
a request that comes as a transfer is credited to its total, then answered by a transfer its client credits
a transfer is credited a window past the bytes received from the start, once half a window can go
a result is sent as far as its credit, a full chunk at a time, and a credit lower than the last grants nothing
a chunk past its credit is answered CREDIT_EXCEEDED, and a late one under it is dropped in silence
a chunk before the last that is not full is answered CHUNK_INVALID
a chunk that says more follow though it reaches the total is answered CHUNK_INVALID
a chunk over bytes received in part is answered CHUNK_INVALID, and one received whole is dropped in silence
a chunk that does not read ends its transfer as CHUNK_INVALID
an opening that holds its whole total is answered CHUNK_INVALID
an opening that declares a total of 0 is answered PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE
a transfer past those a connection receives at once is answered CAPACITY_EXCEEDED
an opening past the budget left is answered CAPACITY_EXCEEDED, and a transfer it starves is credited once it frees
a cancel ends the transfer of a result, and a credit after it is dropped in silence
